gpt-6.1-sol.title: Day 0 support for GPT-6.1 Sol on LiteLLM
gpt-6.1-sol.author: misbahsy
gpt-6.1-sol.text:
GPT-6.1 Sol is now supported on LiteLLM

Call gpt-6.1-sol through the LiteLLM AI Gateway with the request you already send, with spend tracking, rate limits, fallbacks and logging in one place.
Same price as GPT-6 Sol, cheaper cache - $2 / MTok input and $10 output, with cached input halved to $0.10. Per OpenAI, it matches GPT-6 Astra on DeepSWE v1.1 at roughly a fifth of the cost.
Worth checking before you route traffic to it:
OpenAI serves tool calling for this model on the Responses API only;
